rules.sentence: The classic findings on myocardial biopsy of patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy include a thickened myocardium (often specifically in the septum), disorganization of myocyte fibers, myocardial scarring and fibrosis, as well as narrowed vessels and dysplasia of the tunica media cells.
Arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy can be identified pathologically by the replacement of myocytes within the right ventricle with fibrous tissue and fat cells.
